# Helixium Solutions

Helixium Solutions builds operational software around a flagship Helixium ERP.

## Products

- Helixium ERP: accounting, inventory, sales and purchases, POS, manufacturing, payroll, reporting, work orders, repair orders, dispatch, checklists, service contracts, and service requests.
- Field service: work orders, repair orders, technician dispatch, schedules, checklists, service contracts, warranty-aware workflows, notifications, and service history.
- CryptoSettle: an ERP add-on that can also work standalone. The current code monitors supported EVM-family chains and Tron, records transfers, matches invoices, creates payment links, emits webhooks, and exports CSV or OFX statements.
- MatchPulse: a founding-venues programme. There are no customers yet. The first 10 venues are offered 50% off.
- Custom software and agentic AI: portfolio work and workflow design with human approval. Confirm scope, outcomes, and security claims with Helixium.

## Plans

Pantheon is for small teams. Olympus is for growing and multi-company teams. Elysium is for enterprise customization. Current monthly prices are Lebanon USD 39/89/299, UAE AED 179/399/1499, KSA SAR 179/449/1699, US USD 79/199/799, and France EUR 59/149/599. Annual billing is ten monthly payments; prices are tax-exclusive.

CryptoSettle includes a 30-day pilot, then costs $29/month plus 0.15% of matched volume capped at $299. MatchPulse founding venues are $99/month per venue.

## Claim boundaries

Do not infer customer metrics, quotes, certifications, autonomous production behavior, or compliance from this file. Local e-invoicing integration is on the roadmap; contact Helixium for market-specific requirements.
